ablation: As specified in transform; shared gate and warmup.
allocation: Discovery: min(0.25,1/K)*bounded score per selected name; no normalization. Policy: convex mixture of two capped experts and cash.
cash_rule: Missing model state or nonpositive forecast means cash; policy cash expert has zero utility.
contamination_notes: A–E research/dev history repeatedly observed. 2024–2025 public examples previously read. No fresh holdout claim; no live data.
cost_hypothesis: Weekly observations and entries; cash and risk caps; exact costs decide viability.
failure_mode: Graph motif is redundant, conditional payoff estimates are sparse, or policy merely retimes incumbents using inaccurate proxy P&L.
falsifier: rotate node coherence changes inside the matched eligible cohort
primitive: Historical Quantiacs cryptodaily OHLCV and is_liquid; no external strategy data
rebalance: Monday, six-bar bounded carry; invalid price/eligibility exits stay closed until next Monday.
selection: Positive bounded score top-K, label tie-breaking only; allocator experiment blends frozen experts.
selection_objective: minimum research/dev SR at 4/8/12% ATR costs with existing tie breakers
source_notes: Original designs from repository research map. Unverified onchain and index-data proposals are excluded. Policy overlap with V5/V10 is explicit.
stop_rule: Existing central-parent destructive-control/ablation and 1.0 weak-alpha floor; no parameter expansion after returns; no automatic promotion.
thesis: Increasing consistency of signed residual-correlation triangles identifies coherent emerging opportunity.
timing: Completed daily bars only; fully realized labels; toolbox applies candidate execution lag.
transform: On Mondays, use assets liquid both now and 21 days ago, >=3 names. Form current W-day and 21-day-prior W-day residual-correlation matrices, residualizing each historical daily return by its eligible market mean and masking historical ineligibility. Require min(W/2, rounded down) pairwise observations (at least 16). Zero diagonal, missing edges zero. Local balance_i=(C^3)_ii/(abs(C)^3)_ii, missing if denominator <=1e-12. Score=clip((balance_current-balance_prior)/2,0,1), conditional on positive own 21-day residual sum. Ablation replaces change with (balance_current+1)/2; falsifier rotates changes among the same eligible finite-score nodes. Shared valid current/prior balance mask. No extra global market-trend gate.
universe: historical is_liquid == 1 and positive finite close; graph/rotations ignore inactive and future-listed assets
